description_en: If the current scaling group is in the enable state and no scaling activity is in the execute state in the scaling group, you can invoke the RemoveInstances API operation to delete one or more unneeded instances from a scaling group
description_zh: 如果当前伸缩组状态为启用状态，且伸缩组内不存在执行中的伸缩活动，您可以调用API RemoveInstances从一个伸缩组删除一台或多台不再需要的实例
name: RemoveInstances

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the action for the removed ECS instances. Valid values:

recycle: The ECS instances enter the economical mode.

    > This value takes effect only when `ScalingPolicy` is set to `recycle`.

release: The ECS instances are released.

  The `ScalingPolicy` parameter of CreateScalingGroup specifies the reclaim mode of the scaling group, but the specific action when an instance is removed is determined by the `RemovePolicy` parameter of RemoveInstances. Examples:

    - If `ScalingPolicy` is set to `recycle` and `RemovePolicy` is set to `recycle`, the ECS instances enter the economical mode.
    - If `ScalingPolicy` is set to `recycle` and `RemovePolicy` is set to `release`, the ECS instances are released.
    - If `ScalingPolicy` is set to `release` and `RemovePolicy` is set to `recycle`, the ECS instances are released.
    - If `ScalingPolicy` is set to `release` and `RemovePolicy` is set to `release`, the ECS instances are released.

Default value: release
parameters.help_zh:
指定被删除ECS实例的动作。取值范围：

recycle：ECS实例触发了节省停机效果。

    >仅在`ScalingPolicy`为`recycle`时生效。

release：ECS实例被释放。

  CreateScalingGroup的`ScalingPolicy`参数指定伸缩组的回收模式，但实例被删除时的具体动作，由RemoveInstances的`RemovePolicy`参数决定。例如：

    - `ScalingPolicy`为`recycle`，且`RemovePolicy`为`recycle`，ECS实例触发了节省停机效果。
    - `ScalingPolicy`为`recycle`，且`RemovePolicy`为`release`，ECS实例被释放。
    - `ScalingPolicy`为`release`，且`RemovePolicy`为`recycle`，ECS实例被释放。
    - `ScalingPolicy`为`release`，且`RemovePolicy`为`release`，ECS实例被释放。

默认值：release
parameters.name: remove_policy

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to modify the expected number of instances. Valid values:

true: After the ECS instances are removed from the scaling group, the expected number of instances is decreased by the number of removed instances.
false: After the ECS instances are removed from the scaling group, the expected number of instances remains unchanged.

Default value: true
parameters.help_zh:
是否修改期望实例数。取值范围：

true：从伸缩组删除ECS实例后，期望实例数也减少相应台数。
false：从伸缩组删除ECS实例后，期望实例数不会变化。

默认值：true
parameters.name: decrease_desired_capacity

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to ignore invalid instances when you delete a batch of instances from the scaling group. Valid values:

true: Invalid instances are ignored when you delete a batch of instances from the scaling group.
  
  If invalid instances exist in the batch (for example, the instance status is `Adding`) and you successfully delete the valid instances, the execute status of the scaling activity is displayed as `Warning`. You can view the invalid instances in the scaling activity details.
false: Invalid instances are not ignored when you delete a batch of instances from the scaling group.

  If invalid instances exist in the batch, an error is returned.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
从伸缩组删除一批实例时，是否忽略其中无效的实例。取值范围：

true：从伸缩组中删除一批实例时会忽略无效实例。
  
  如果一批实例中存在无效实例（例如实例状态为`加入中`），并且有效的实例被成功删除时，伸缩活动执行状态显示为`警告`状态，您可以从伸缩活动详情查看无效的实例。
false：从伸缩组中删除一批实例时不会忽略无效实例。

  如果一批实例中存在无效的实例，则返回结果会报错。

默认值：false
parameters.name: ignore_invalid_instance

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the ECS instances to be removed
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Ensures the idempotence of the request.

You can generate a parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique across different requests. The value can only contain ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The timeout period for waiting for the ECS instances to be stopped during the scale-in process. Unit: seconds.
Valid values: 30 to 240.

By default, this parameter value is inherited from the scaling group. You can also reset it when calling RemoveInstances.
This parameter takes effect only in the scale-in process when RemovePolicy is set to release.  
If this parameter is set, the system waits for a maximum of the StopInstanceTimeout period for the instances to be stopped. After the timeout period elapses, the scale-in process continues regardless of whether the instances are successfully stopped.  
If this parameter is not set, the system waits for a long time for the instances to be stopped. The scale-in process continues only after the instances are successfully stopped. If the instances fail to be stopped, the scale-in process is rolled back and the scale-in fails
parameters.help_zh:
缩容流程中等待ECS实例停机成功的超时时间，单位为秒。
取值范围：30~240。

该参数值默认从伸缩组继承，您也可以在调用RemoveInstances时重新设置。
该参数仅在 RemovePolicy = release 模式下的缩容流程里生效。  
如果设置了该参数，系统会最长等待StopInstanceTimeout时间将实例停机成功，超时后无论实例是否成功停机都会继续缩容。  
如果没有设置该参数，系统会长时间等待实例停机成功，只有实例停机成功后才继续缩容，停机失败时，缩容流程会回滚，缩容失败
parameters.name: stop_instance_timeout

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to disable all lifecycle hooks for the scaling activity. Valid values:

true: Disables all lifecycle hooks.
false: Does not disable lifecycle hooks
fields.help_zh:

true：禁用。
false：不禁用
